hardRules: Preserve `artist_music` and every existing upload, private storage, signed-stream, access-control, Jukebox, mobile, feed, profile, EPK, marketplace, analytics, licensing, royalty and rights-administration path.

Never reset or destructively rewrite the database; use additive migrations, explicit backfills, versioned records, default-deny RLS, feature flags, append-only audit/outbox events and compensating actions.
Tourify remains an optional provider; the cultural-memory trust, custodians, finding aids, preservation profiles, restrictions, remedies and continuity functions must operate without Tourify.
No Phase 20 capability ships under Phase 19 flags and no trust participation, deposit, cultural authority, custody, access or reuse permission is inferred from Phase 19 participation.
Preservation, custody, discovery, access, disclosure, reuse, ownership and legal authority are separate decisions.

No trust, custodian, council, archive, identifier, credential, public projection or elapsed time creates copyright, licensing, collection, payment, enforcement, representation or public-law authority.
No compulsory deposit, universal identity, unrestricted public access, perpetual legal authority or global representation is created.
Communities, creators and lawful local organizations retain exact-scope cultural authority, withdrawal, correction, restriction, repatriation and provider-choice rights.
Current authoritative source, custody, community, privacy, restriction, jurisdiction, legal-hold, dispute, suspension, revocation and expiry records control high-impact actions.
Public identifiers and finding aids support discovery only and never authorize a high-impact action alone.
Sensitive, sacred, secret and culturally restricted materials are default-deny for access and reuse.
AI training, voice or style modeling, embedding generation, bulk extraction and commercial reuse are default-deny and require separate explicit authority.
Historical actions retain their original policy, schema, authority, jurisdiction, evidence, restrictions and semantic context.
Every critical component supports export, independent implementation, custodian replacement, archive restore, decommissioning and Tourify-unavailable operation.

Stop rather than degrade when legal structure, cultural authority, consent, custody, privacy, source lineage, preservation capability, funding, staffing, external contract or independent review is unclear.
